build.description: Build a Rust crate with `cargo build`.

check.description: Type-check a Rust crate with `cargo check`.

clippy.description: Lint a Rust crate with `cargo clippy`.

lint.description: Alias for `clippy`. Runs `cargo clippy` against a crate.

fmt.description: Format a Rust crate with `cargo fmt`.

run.description: Run a Rust binary with `cargo run`.

test.description: Test a Rust crate with `cargo test`.

release-publish.description: Publish a Rust crate to a registry. Invoke via `nx release publish`, not directly.
